title: Conduction is the only lead cross-validated by two independent routes — Nextcloud ISV and Common Ground
content:
Conduction does Common Ground delivery, works on OpenCatalogi, and is a Nextcloud ISV launch partner. The research's finding is not any one of those facts but how they were found: the firm surfaced twice, independently — once through the Nextcloud ISV programme and once through Common Ground.

Cross-validation is a property of the research process rather than of the company, and the research notes that nothing else in the corpus has it. Two independent routes converging on the same small firm means its position is not an artefact of one list; it is visible from more than one direction in the Dutch open-source municipal ecosystem, which is a meaningful check when most leads rest on a single sighting.

The remaining attributes are what make the lead workable: small, open-source-native, municipal. Small firms decide quickly, open-source-native removes the licence conversation, and municipal work is where the decision-record requirement originates. Together with the double sighting, that is why it is marked 'start here'.
